blurb: Windwalker Farms Sporting Clays is committed to providing opportunities for the shotgun enthusiast. We have been rated one of the top 10 shooting clubs in the state of Texas and among the top 15 in the nation. We are best known for our unique shooting stations and world class targets. Our current layout has two sporting clay courses with a total of 30 stations, along with a 5-stand, and a trap and skeet field.
